verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents a per-merchant 'Needs Information' application status, which signals additional requirements for a seller. It also lets platforms configure real-time verifications to run before submission, a limited form of tuning onboarding friction. Nothing shows progressive onboarding, where a seller starts selling on minimal data and the rest is collected before a payout threshold. missing for 10: minimum-to-start / deferred KYC tiers, payout-threshold-gated requirement collection, detailed requirements-due fields and deadlines per seller, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, onboarding friction is tunable — collect the minimum to start selling and gather the rest before payout thresholds, with clear requirements-due states per seller

citations.quote: Merchant application moves to the **Needs Information** status and requires additional verification for merchant onboarding
Configuring these verifications to run before submission reduces data entry errors and potentially expedites the application approval process.
